Cors.//: Exact browser origins allowed to call this API in Production, e.g. https://uni-shop.com. Native mobile clients send no Origin header and are unaffected. Empty in Production = deny all cross-origin calls.

JwtSettings.//: SECURITY: Secret is intentionally absent from this file. Supply it at runtime via the JwtSettings__Secret environment variable or `dotnet user-secrets set JwtSettings:Secret "<value>"`. Minimum 32 bytes (256 bits). Startup fails fast if it is missing, so the app can never boot with a committed key that anyone could use to forge an admin token.

Media.//: Absolute base URL for uploaded images. Uploads live under FTD.Web/wwwroot, so when the API is hosted separately this MUST point at the web host or CDN — otherwise relative paths are unresolvable from a mobile client. Left empty, the API falls back to its own scheme+host.

MobileApp.//: Remote app control. Raising MinSupportedVersion forces older installs to update, and MaintenanceMode shows a maintenance screen — both without a code deployment.
